sections.title: Sound of letter bê
paragraphs: The letter is named (bê) /be/. Its main sound is heard in (bom) /bõ/, which means good. This letter makes two sounds.

sections.title: How to say letter bê
paragraphs: For the first sound, close both lips fully to stop the air. Release your lips cleanly with voice. Touch your throat to feel it shake. For the second sound, bring both lips close together without touching. Let the voiced air flow smoothly through the narrow gap.

sections.title: Spelling of letter bê
paragraphs: This letter makes its stopped sound at the start of a word in (bom) /bõ/. It makes the same sound after a consonant in (ombro) /ˈõ.bɾu/. It makes its flowing sound between vowels in casual speech in (cabo) /ˈka.βu/ and in (saber) /sɐˈβeɾ/.

sections.title: Mistakes with letter bê
paragraphs: Between vowels, do not pop your lips open as in the English word cabin. Do not touch your lower lip to your upper teeth as in vine. Keep both lips close together, and let the voiced air glide through smoothly.
